This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

Contestants try to answer trivia answers correctly to collect spins on a gameboard, where they can win cash and prizes. Unless, of course, they land on a "Whammy," which takes away the player's loot. The contestant with the most accumulated cash and prizes at the end of the show is the winner.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

In need of a vacation from his ordinary life, factory worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall, a company that can turn dreams into real memories. Thinking that memories of life as a superspy are just the ticket, Quaid undergoes the procedure -- but it goes horribly wrong. Suddenly, Quaid is a hunted man. He teams up with a rebel fighter on a search to find the head of the underground resistance and take down the leader of the free world.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Mystery, Thriller

When his parents, the caliph and queen, are murdered by usurper Ali (Gregory Gaye), the newborn Ramoth is delivered to the safety of his uncle, Ahkmid (William Fawcett), via a magic carpet. The adult Ramoth (John Agar) becomes masked hero the Scarlet Falcon. After tricking the reigning caliph into appointing him the royal physician, Ramoth learns of his noble birth and, with the help of faithful Razi (George Tobias) and beautiful Lida (Patricia Medina), he fights Ali and his wrathful minions.
A composer (Melvyn Douglas) goes on a cruise and meets a woman (Ruth Hussey) he likes more than his wife (Ellen Drew).

With a terminal diagnosis that has left him with just months to live, insurance salesman Peter (Jerry Lewis) decides to take an extravagant, around-the-world fishing tour. Mid-trip, Peter is informed by his doctor, Scott (Peter Lawford), that a malfunctioning electrocardiograph had caused a misdiagnosis and he will live. Now, faced with crippling debt from his travels, Peter resolves to fake his own death to secure a life insurance claim for his wife, Nancy (Anne Francis).
Three men get mixed up with some Martian spies' invention.

Lt. Rip Crandall (Jack Lemmon) is entrusted with one of the most important missions of his World War II career: to shuttle an Australian spy (Chips Rafferty) into enemy territory. Unfortunately, he'll be doing it with one of the Navy's least seaworthy vessels, the USS Echo. But even in a clunker of a ship, Crandall and his madcap crew -- including his enthusiastic young ensign (Ricky Nelson) -- do their best to make their ill-equipped mission a success.

In this award-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical based on the Charles Dickens novel, 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist (Mark Lester) falls in with a group of street-urchin pickpockets led by the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild) and masterminded by the criminal Fagin (Ron Moody). When Oliver's intended mark, Mr. Brownlow (Joseph O'Conor), takes pity on the lad and offers him a home, Fagin's henchman Bill Sikes (Oliver Reed) plots to kidnap the boy to keep him from talking.

During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.
A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).
Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.
An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.
A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.

As the French and Indian Wars rage on, Hawkeye and those he cares about get caught up along with it. While helping to keep a British fort from falling into the hands of the Crown's enemies, he encounters Mabel Dunham—a beautiful woman who almost immediately raises the suspicions of Chingachgook, Hawkeye's Native American father. He warns his son not to trust the whites, but will the youth follow his father's advice or his own heart?

While being escorted to jail, bank robber Jim Larsen (Fred MacMurray) manages to get the upper hand on his captor and escape. Jim is surprised to see his brother appear on the scene, ready to aid his sibling. As they make their getaway, his brother and the pursuing lawman shoot each other, leaving the stunned Jim alone and on the run. Assuming a different identity, Jim travels to a mining town and befriends the local sheriff (Lin McCarthy), hoping to start over and find redemption.
Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
Fabiola, una joven enfermera, huye de la muerte de su madre y del abuso sexual de su padrastro; junto con su amiga Arleth, conquista hombres adinerados para drogarlos y robarles.

Un niño sobreviviente de cáncer regresa a su escuela, pero debido a las secuelas de su enfermedad, el pequeño se vuelve víctima de bullying. Gracias a la intervención de su mamá, amigos y su maestra, el agresor recibirá una lección.
Una joven está obsesionada con su maestro de canto y mentirá diciendo que está embarazada de él. Para sostener la mentira, romperá una relación, fingirá un secuestro, y tendrá problemas con la ley.

La Güera, el Gandalla y el Chulo son una banda robacasas que marca los domicilios para cometer los hurtos; Raúl, un policía de investigación, llega al vecindario para tomar control de la banda, pero sus acciones son descubiertas muy pronto.

Para sentirse amada, una joven trata de ganarse el corazón de un chico haciendo siempre lo que él le pide, lo que la lleva a los excesos y no hacer caso de advertencias. Los padres de la joven se darán cuenta muy tarde del error de su hija.

Melisa tiene un momento de debilidad y piensa que el bebé que espera echará a perder su vida y le quitará tiempo. No es sino hasta que Valentino está al borde de la muerte, que a su mamá le brota el amor maternal y le pide perdón por su rechazo.

Ileana decide poner pastillas antidepresivos en las bebidas de su mejor amiga Gabriela, quien se queda dormida o se desmaya en los ensayos para una obra de teatro, pero ella misma se pone en evidencia.

Un joven sale del tutelar de menores para enmendar los errores del pasado y ser un mejor ejemplo para su hermano menor, pero este se mete en problemas al relacionarse con la banda que una vez traicionó a su hermano.
Gerardo y Pablo tienen problemas de convivencia; uno de ellos se ha quedado huérfano y se va a vivir con sus padrinos, y el otro despierta de un coma después de 10 años.

Mientras dos niños son abandonados por su madre, una mujer no quiere tener más hijos y dedicarle tiempo a su hija. El destino une a los niños con la mujer cuando decide apoyarlo con la atención médica que requieren.
Madre e hija encuentran, en un afamado conferencista, un camino para salir adelante del sufrimiento luego de que fueron abandonadas, pero estarán en peligro, ya que solo quieren sacarles dinero.

Dori ayuda a Chema a conseguir empleo en el centro nocturno en el que ella trabaja. Chema pronto se da cuenta de todo lo que ocurre en ese lugar, lo que provoca que su vida corra peligro, pero un agente encubierto intervendrá en el momento oportuno.
Teen Amy Fisher shoots her 35-year-old lover's wife in the head; a reality TV star finds herself behind bars for fraud.
Fashion designer Rudolph Moshammer is murdered by a male prostitute; musician Tim Lambesis gets caught up in a murder-for-hire plot.
A homegrown terrorism group plans a jihad in Southern California; a U.S. representative scams investors out of millions of dollars.
A prison inmate attacks more than 20 guards and countless prisoners, and takes 11 hostages; the largest online manhunt to date.
Years after being found not guilty of the murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman, OJ Simpson was back in a courtroom and again facing felony charges.
Ten years after being found guilty of the murder of her husband, Susie Mowbray's conviction was overturned, and she would once again face a jury of her peers.

While driving under the influence of drugs and alcohol, Chante Mallard allegedly struck pedestrian Gregory Biggs, impaling him in the windshield; what she did and didn't do next, is what turned a terrible accident into a shocking case of murder.
Vinnie Politan takes a deep dive into the true-crime stories that are captivating the world over.
Attorneys work to get a death row inmate who confessed to a crime he didn't commit out of prison.
The ex-wife of an entrepreneur with powerful connections who was blown up in his car speaks out.
A cell phone video is evidence in a murder trial.
Bart makes a bid for an old ship only to find out that its valuable cargo is opium.

Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.
Lucas becomes involved in the family troubles of the hotel clerk.
Fallen ill, a couple seeks shelter with Lucas.
Bret is left to face a bum murder rap and a gun-hungry band of desperados after meeting Gentleman Jack Darby.
Sheriff Alden Rockwell teams up with a big city cop to investigate the murder of a not-so-popular lawyer.
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.
Seeking revenge for a poker game gone bad, gunslinger Doc West finds himself in the local town jail. When a battle among the townspeople breaks out, he must choose sides.
A dance hall girl steals money from Bart.
Maverick must help Dandy Jim Buckley escape from jail in order to recover swindled money.
Fictional account of the development of the Gatling gun and the impact it had on the Western frontier.

Devon Major (Sebastian Spence) is charged with murdering his ex-wife after he finds her body in her house. He asks Susan Grace (Vanessa Angel), his wife's best friend and a former criminal lawyer, to defend him.

Kendra is thrilled to meet Brad, a handsome TV star, at a party. When she discovers that Brad is not as charming as he seems, Kendra rejects him, only to realize that he has become obsessed with her and will stop at nothing to be near her.
Maura becomes a murder suspect when her date is found dead, and she can not remember their evening together; Jane struggles to protect her best friend while doing her job.
Maura gains insight into her father; Korsak opens up about Cavanaugh's tragic past; Maura and Jane unravel a shocking secret about Paddy and Hope.
A viral video of Jane jeopardizes her career and reputation; the squad tries to solve a murder case involving a conspiracy theorist.
A popular high-school teacher is killed in a hit-and-run; Jane is preoccupied with Lt. Martinez's apparent favoritism toward his own drug unit.
Frankie Jr. is brought in to help with a murder case involving a youth hockey league; Cailin asks to stay with Maura; Maura has trouble living with a teenager.
Jane and Maura are asked to present the case of a serial killer at a symposium for law enforcement; Jane and Maura make a discovery.

A girl falls victim to two high-school classmates, who film what they believe is their murderous path toward immortality; when a teen tries to break away from a group of aspiring mobsters, he becomes their first victim.
A teenager with schizophrenia decides that it is his mission to kill everyone in the world; a cheerleader is killed in Orinda, Calif.
An 8-year-old vanishes without a trace; a teen is set up and slaughtered to death by his friends.
A girl goes missing, and the perpetrator turns out to be a 15-year-old thrill killer; a teenager poisons her grandmother with no apparent reason.
When their parents disapprove of a teenage couple, the outcome is homicidal leaving a family in tatters; a lonely, young girl is befriended by a group of disaffected teens.
A sibling rivalry causes Ronald Salazar to become a killer; police chase a young serial killer.
The brutalized body of a female student is found on the University of Tennessee campus; a young man disappears in Texas.
Chronicling the lives and work of conservation officers in America.
Mario explores the coast of Cape Town, where the Indian Ocean meets the Atlantic, and tries to catch yellowfin tuna.

Deep in the wilderness of Northern South Africa, poaching is rife, and the wilderness is as dangerous as it gets; Mario attempts to be the first in the area to have ever harvested one of the most dangerous animals known to Africa, the Cape buffalo.
Best friends Ed Cohen and Ken Henderson set out for two days of Texas gulf fishing, but tragedy strikes and the two men get stranded adrift in hostile waters.
A spear fisherman suddenly faces a deadly shark attack.
A parachute jump doesn't go according to plan for a group of skydivers; a hazardous storm in Taiwan endangers some motorists.
A helicopter accident causes chaos in the workplace; a snow truck rescue attempt goes wrong; a construction worker is trapped.
Brave volunteers face treacherous landscapes to rescue those in peril across the UK.
In Newquay, teams search for an aircraft following reports it's crashed at sea; Humberside Search and Rescue help a woman who fell walking her dog on the cliffs.

In Yorkshire, Neil needs urgent attention after a fall from his motorbike; the medics head to the banks of Ullswater when a walker goes into a cardiac arrest; in Berkshire, Darran suffers nasty burns in an accident lighting a bonfire.
A father and son set out on a cliffside sheep hunt, but one slip could mean life or death in the remote and unforgiving area.
Father and son bow hunters fight off a deadly grizzly bear attack.
The world's leading disease researchers provide insights on the outbreaks of Swine Flu and Ebola in places as diverse as West Africa, Hong Kong and Germany.
In the Lakes, a walker sustains a limb-threatening injury, a fisherman severs a finger, and Keswick Mountain Rescue Team help a team member's wife after a fall.

In Hartlepool, the heli-medics are tasked with treating a man hit by a train; cyclist Trevor suffers serious injuries after a collision with a car; motocross biker Arai in Cumbria is flown across the country for emergency surgery.

A woman is badly hurt after being knocked down a bank by her pet goat, a man is found with serious injuries on a remote beach, and an 11-year-old girl has fallen down a bank and may have suffered spinal injuries.

A motorcycle rider falls off a cliff and is stuck in a ravine; a family's waterskiing outing turns serious when a newlywed crashes; a young boy's life is at risk after he is hit by a van while running to his mother.
Following the Westpac Rescue crew as they respond to a shark attack victim, a fisherman caught in a risky spot and an elderly man with chest pain.
In order to limit violence and criminality in Madagascar and Reunion Island, special police units are created to monitor the island streets.
Mike and Frank chase a legend that could be a real buried treasure in Springfield, Massachusetts, the birthplace of Indian Motorcycles.

The guys stop at a sprawling farm with 14 jam-packed trailers; an eccentric mother-daughter duo sells an 1856 home; the guys visit an old cheese factory that's been boarded up for years.

A sprawling warehouse and overstuffed semi trailers on Kevin's New England property; a former race car driver with an amazing collection of automotive artifacts; a sprawling Harley-Davidson honey hole.
On a 100-acre property in Arkansas, Mike falls hard for a midget racecar with a Knucklehead motor and prize-winning pedigree.

Lucy (Anais Granofsky) is torn between romance and politics when the basketball team captain invites her to a dance. With Dale Cameron, Irene Courakos.
Tim's (Keith White) good-night kiss awakens bad memories for Liz (Cathy Keenan); Joey (Pat Mastroianni) is not happy with his houseguest.
There is more than one surprise at Diana's (Chrisa Erodotou) birthday party when Kathleen (Rebecca Haines) finds marijuana.

Lucy, Heather and Erica (Anais Granofsky, Maureen Deiseach, Angela Deiseach) sneak into the filming of a rock video.
Jenna sets her sights on Sav to be a father figure for her baby despite the fact that he is dating Holly J.
Jenna jeopardizes Sav and Holly J.'s relationship; K.C. decides to step up; Adam's plan for a magical night falls through.

Drew's friends disapprove of his relationship with Bianca, and he has to make a choice.

When Alli goes missing, Sav believes that she is just pulling a stunt to get attention.
Flynn leads the others on a rescue mission, which leads them into a subterranean trap filled with ancient Egyptian werewolves.

After seeing a vision of her own death at the hands of a supernatural assassin, Baird attempts to stop the deadly prophecy from coming true.
The librarians investigate a traveling carnival where they discover the sinister secret of a magician who has been corrupted by the use of real magic.

An adventurer (Noah Wyle) and a brilliant archaeologist (Gabrielle Anwar) use a map to search for the fabled mines of King Solomon.
When people begin suffering the effects of accidents and sins in which they have not been involved, the team tracks the connection to Dorian Gray.
The team is sent to a high-tech research facility where the researchers have been turned into mindless monsters by a bizarre power source in the center's lab.
The team scatters and each person begins living the ideal version of their life; the appearance of Ariel brings everyone together to investigate.

The Egyptian God of Chaos inhabits a human, and tries to release pure evil into the world; the librarians must decipher clues in a science museum.

Each episode gives viewers an inside look at television, film and music, including interviews with each industry's biggest stars. Over the years, many celebrities have "broken their silence" regarding various scandals or tragedies with hosts and correspondents from "ET." In addition to covering breaking news, the show visits sets of movies and TV shows and heads to the red carpet to cover awards shows and other major events. Airing daily since 1981, "Entertainment Tonight" is the template by which many other entertainment newsmagazines are based.
Taking a closer look at some of the people, places, and things brought to viewers every weekend.

For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family.

Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

After learning in Hellraiser II that he used to be British air force Capt. Elliot Spencer (Doug Bradley) -- before he was sucked into another dimension and turned into the pain-craving creature known as Pinhead -- Spencer's soul ends up in limbo. Meanwhile, Pinhead is sealed in a column, which is bought by J.P. Monroe (Kevin Bernhardt). In a dream, reporter Joey Summerskill (Terry Farrell) learns from Spencer she must reunite his two halves to send the murderous Pinhead back to his world.
Movie, Horror, Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Fantasy

When a cockroach-spread plague threatens to decimate the child population of New York City, evolutionary biologist Susan Tyler (Mira Sorvino) and her research associates rig up a species of "Judas" bugs and introduce them into the environment, where they will mimic the diseased roaches and infiltrate their grubby habitats. So far so good ... until the bugs keep on evolving and learn to mimic their next prey -- humans.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbor Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

In the wake of her mother's death in a mental institution, detective Rita Veder (Angela Bassett) is assigned to a baffling serial murder case. After examining the crime scene -- a corpse-filled ship found adrift at sea -- Rita meets Maximilian (Eddie Murphy), a smooth-talking Caribbean playboy determined to romance her. When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

Wren (Victoria Justice) is a high-school senior who can't wait to get away from her dysfunctional family. On Halloween, Wren's mother decides to go out with her much-younger boyfriend, leaving Wren to look after little brother Albert. When Wren is distracted by an invitation to the party of the year, Albert disappears into a sea of trick-or-treaters. Enlisting the aid of her sassy friend, April (Jane Levy), and two other classmates, Wren sets out on a frantic search for her sibling.
Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.

Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies.

Playful Pee-wee Herman (Paul Reubens) operates a fantastical farm with talking animals and hot-dog trees. One day, after a giant tornado hits, Pee-wee finds a circus has landed in his yard. He befriends the manager, Mace Montana (Kris Kristofferson), and develops a crush on a trapeze performer (Valeria Golino), even though he already has a fiancée (Penelope Ann Miller). Pee-wee tries to excite the town about the new circus, but most of the residents want it gone and harass Pee-wee because of it.
The misadventures of three ingenious orphans and the villainous actor Count Olaf who wants their enormous fortune.

Después de diez semanas donde los momentos de diversión, alegría y emoción se hicieron presentes, los pequeños viven el último programa de la competencia con un gran performance al lado de grandes artistas como Paulina Rubio.

Biby Gaytán, María León, Albertano y Juanpa Zurita se unen a la nueva temporada y tendrán la tarea de seleccionar a los pequeños competidores. Los escuadrones quedan atrás y la competencia se vuelve individual.
Los jueces se dan a la tarea de seleccionar a los últimos participantes. Los aspirantes se enfrentan en una serie de duelos donde tendrán que demostrar sus cualidades de canto y baile.

As a child living in Africa, Jill Young (Charlize Theron) saw her mother killed while protecting wild gorillas from poachers led by Andrei Strasser (Rade Serbedzija). Now an adult, Jill cares for an orphaned gorilla named Joe -- who, due to a genetic anomaly, is 15 feet tall. When Gregg O'Hara (Bill Paxton) arrives from California and sees the animal, he convinces Jill that Joe would be safest at his wildlife refuge. But Strasser follows them to the U.S., intent on capturing Joe for himself.

The Worth family has been divided for years, but when the matriarch, grandma Mabel, dies suddenly, the family has to come together. Her death takes the family on a journey, discovering that not only did grandma Mabel keep some secrets, so did everyone else. They find their way back to each other and realize that while you can't choose your family, you can choose to be friends with them.

When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

In this film based on the William Gibson story, Johnny (Keanu Reeves) is a data courier who has a secret stash of information implanted into his mind. However, the data will kill Johnny if he cannot retrieve it within 48 hours. Accompanied by physically enhanced bodyguard Jane (Dina Meyer), Johnny sets out to acquire the passwords he needs to save himself. Worse yet, he is hunted by gangster Shinji (Denis Akiyama) and businessman Takahashi (Takeshi), both of whom seek the data Johnny possesses.

The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

Thomas (Dylan O'Brien), a teenager, arrives in a glade at the center of a giant labyrinth. Like the other youths dumped there before him, he has no memory of his previous life. Thomas quickly becomes part of the group and soon after demonstrates a unique perspective that scores him a promotion to Runner status -- those who patrol the always-changing maze to find an escape route. Together with Teresa (Kaya Scodelario), the only female, Thomas tries to convince his cohorts that he knows a way out.

Doctors (Treat Williams, Mary Page Keller) try to find a cure for a deadly virus inflicted by rattlesnake bites.
After exposing police corruption, an honest lawman must prove his innocence when he is framed for a drug scam.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

Sparks fly between a best man and a maid of honor as they work together to save their friends' wedding.

After a year of living with girlfriend Grace (Kerry Washington), Wade Walker (Craig Robinson) is eager to propose to her, but she's still reluctant to introduce him to her snobbish family. When Grace leaves for a gathering at her parents' swanky compound, he hatches a plan to crash the assemblage, charm her folks, and slip a ring on her finger. However, his scheme soon goes awry, and Wade realizes that his only chance of marrying her is a take-no-prisoners confrontation with her father.

After discovering they are all dating the same guy, three popular students from different cliques band together for revenge, so they enlist the help of a new gal in town and conspire to break the jerk's heart, while destroying his reputation.

Best friends Grace (Selena Gomez) and Emma (Katie Cassidy) quit their waitress jobs in small-town Texas and head to Paris for a summer adventure, accompanied by Grace's stepsister, Meg (Leighton Meester). The prepackaged tour fails to meet their expectations, however, and soon their spirits sag. But, when Grace is mistaken for a British socialite named Cordelia, she and her companions head to Monte Carlo to enjoy a week of yacht parties and cute bachelors -- then the real Cordelia arrives.

Warren's apocalyptic dream of a Black Rainbow sends the group on a mysterious new mission while fighting for their lives against unkillable MAD-Z's.
Driven by her dream of a Black Rainbow and flesh eating rain, Warren and Murphy escape Zona; Doc, 10K and Sarge are pinned down by snipers.
When Sun Mei and Red vanish, 10K and the group must decide whether to keep looking for them, or give up and press on to Newmerica.
Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing The Great Pile, a seemingly endless landscape of rubble and destruction.
The team is captured by an Unseen Force and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility, forced by their mysterious captors to perform a series of bizarre, dangerous tasks.
Lucy fights to save Murphy's life; Warren and the others battle a biologically modified Franken-Zombie guarding a clue to Warren's dream.
Shaken by the death of one of the team, something snaps in Murphy, and Warren is unable to stop him and the others from committing an atrocity as misplaced revenge.
Warren and the others encounter a mysterious stranger who they think is a grave robber, but they're something much more.
The group explores an abandoned TV news station and encounters news crew zombies triggering haunting flashbacks from day one.
Doc and the group are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working barber shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters.
Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task without knowing why.
Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks and funny observations; entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.
A heavy storm hits St. Josephine, which opens the door for some emotional conversations; Calvin and Nova share a tough moment; an unexpected stranger arrives in town.

In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter.

When biker Cary Ford (Martin Henderson) discovers some motorcycles filled with crystal meth, he stows them away. But it turns out that villainous gangster Henry James (Matt Schulze) has plans to recover his drugs. James frames Ford for the murder of Junior (Fredro Starr), the brother of Trey (Ice Cube), who heads the Reapers, a notoriously malicious biker gang. Ford goes on the run in an attempt to clear his name, while the FBI and multiple groups of motorcycle-mounted marauders chase after him.

Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first.

John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers.

Russell Walker has started a new hip-hop and rap label called Krush Groove, which features a stellar list of acts that includes Kurtis Blow and Run-D.M.C. However, Walker doesn't have sufficient money to keep up the label, especially after Run-D.M.C. scores a big single. As he struggles to fund the label, more and more rap groups, like the Beastie Boys and LL Cool J, emerge in the New York City hip-hop scene. The film is based on the beginning of Def Jam Records.

A Texas Ranger (Liam Hemsworth) investigates a series of murders in an Old West town that's run by a former Confederate officer (Woody Harrelson).
A fallen swordsman (Clive Owen) leads a small army against a sadistic ruler to avenge his dishonored master (Morgan Freeman).

Caius Martius, aka Coriolanus (Ralph Fiennes), is an arrogant and fearsome general who has built a career on protecting Rome from its enemies. Pushed by his ambitious mother (Vanessa Redgrave) to seek the position of consul, Coriolanus is at odds with the masses and unpopular with certain colleagues (James Nesbitt, Paul Jesson). When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, Coriolanus seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler). Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.
Shipwrecked in a strange land, marauding Vikings must battle a band of mercenaries after kidnapping the daughter of a Scottish king.

As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

In 1931, the Bondurant brothers of Franklin County, Va., run a multipurpose backwoods establishment that hides their true business, bootlegging. Middle brother Forrest (Tom Hardy) is the brain of the operation; older Howard (Jason Clarke) is the brawn, and younger Jack (Shia LaBeouf), the lookout. Though the local police have taken bribes and left the brothers alone, a violent war erupts when a sadistic lawman (Guy Pearce) from Chicago arrives and tries to shut down the Bondurants operation.
Frost joins forces with Christine Moorhead during a raid on a dogfight in which a boy is killed.
The automobile in a hit-and-run accident is traced to a powerful member of Parliament. David Jason stars.
Frost's (David Jason) informant, a young mother, is murdered.
Frost fears the presence of a serial killer when a helpless old woman is murdered without motive.
Frost links the death of a young drug addict to an intriguing case of blackmail involving a prominent doctor.
When an undercover officer is killed, Frost must force his colleagues to cooperate in the investigation.
In Mobile, the homicide team takes on a missing persons case when new evidence points to foul play.
In Mobile, a professor of economics is found shot dead outside his bedroom door when he doesn't show up for class.

A St. Louis man is shot in his apartment with only his girlfriend with him, but she claims she had nothing to do with it; Tulsa, Okla., detectives need the childhood friend of a shooting victim to tell the truth about the crime in front of her home.

In Georgia's Gwinnett County, a man is gunned down in the early morning on his front lawn, the engine of his truck still running behind him; Detective James Lawson unravels a tangled web of jealousy and betrayal in order to find his killer.
A young man is shot down while walking home and rumors swirl about who could have wanted him dead.
In Tulsa, Okla., a homeless man is beaten and stabbed to death, leading detectives to witnesses that live under the bridge where he was discovered.
A father of four is gunned down while defending his girlfriend during a brutal home invasion.

Mrs. Ochmonek (Liz Sheridan) thinks she's seeing things when she spots ALF the alien in the backyard.
ALF joins a monastery after learning that his parents were married before he was born -- a disgrace on the planet Melmac.
The Tanners become a TV ratings family, and ALF decides to rig the system so that his favorite program becomes a hit.
ALF becomes the star attraction at the Tanners' Halloween party. With Anne Schedeen and Andrea Elson.
ALF helps Lynn (Andrea Elson) boost her self-confidence by enrolling her in a beauty pageant. With Max Wright, Anne Schedeen and Benji Gregory.
ALF gets a severe case of hiccups after being excluded from Dorothy and Whizzer's (Anne Meara, Paul Dooley) wedding party.
Willie and ALF hop on board a freight train in search of adventure.
ALF and the Tanner kids give Willie and Kate a second honeymoon.
Kate dreams that she and ALF are rival presidential candidates. Political commentator John McLaughlin makes an appearance.
ALF is trapped in a box of toys going to a children's hospital.
ALF is trapped in a box of toys going to a children's hospital.
ALF befriends the Ochmoneks' belligerent nephew (Josh Blake). With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
ALF demands a fair trial after being accused of throwing a ball through the Ochmoneks' window. With Max Wright and Ann Schedeen.
ALF believes that he scared Willie's (Max Wright) uncle to death. With Ann Schedeen.
ALF lends a hand with the neighborhood block patrol and ends up confronting a prowler in the Ochmoneks' house.
It's up to Willie to save ALF from the SWAT team surrounding the Ochomonek house, in which ALF had been chasing a prowler.
ALF moves in with his blind friend, Jody, and learns some important lessons about life without sight.
ALF, jealous of the attention a stray dog is getting, gives the pooch to a mean old woman who claims to be the owner.
Willie abandons his belief in pacifism after meeting the hostile father of the kid who has been bullying Brian.
Willie has problems trying to sell the house because ALF keeps scaring off potential buyers with phony ghosts.
ALF's mail-order ventriloquist's dummy takes on a life of its own. Bill Daily and Fred Gross guest star.
Kate's (Anne Schedeen) friend (Dorothy Lyman), a known drinker, sees ALF in the kitchen and thinks she's hallucinating.
ALF fantasizes that he reveals his existence to the world and serves as substitute host on David Letterman's show.
ALF decides to have some fun while a nervous Mrs. Ochmonek (Liz Sheridan) baby-sits Brian (Benji Gregory).
ALF hides out in the back seat during Lynn's date at the drive-in.
In a fantasy sequence, ALF's guardian angel shows him what the Tanners' lives would be like without him.
The Tanners let Trevor Ochmonek (John La Motta) stay at their house after he has a fight with his wife (Liz Sheridan). With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

Tinja is a 12-year-old gymnast who's desperate to please her image-obsessed mother. After finding a wounded bird in the woods, she brings its strange egg home, nestles it in her bed and nurtures it until it hatches. The creature that emerges soon becomes her closest friend and a living nightmare, plunging Tinja into a twisted reality that her mom refuses to see.
A pregnant police officer and a blind man fight for their lives against swarms of the living dead.
Malevolent aliens interrupt five collegians' vacation at a remote woodland cabin.

A man and his pregnant wife become trapped in their car when a storm buries them underneath layers of snow and ice. As supplies dwindle and temperatures plunge, the couple must battle the elements and hypothermia in a desperate fight for survival.
Once a victim of vicious bullying, a teenage girl (Sierra McCormick) rises from the grave to punish the tormentors of a new student (Ronen Rubinstein) at a remote school.

Samantha inherits a house from family she never knew and goes to the property with three friends to see it. Shortly after their arrival, Samantha experiences horrific visions as the demons from her past refuse to stay buried.
Waking nightmares, bloodthirsty spirits, demonic forces, and vengeful poltergeists visit horror upon their victims in this anthology.

Princesa asusta a los caballos de Eugene, Yumiko y Ezequiel, pero les promete otro medio de transporte. Mientras, Beta, en estado de delirio psicótico, guía a la horda de zombis hacia Alejandría para destruirlo todo.

Los seguidores de Beta se acercan a las puertas, y parte del grupo se impregna de sangre de zombi para intentar escapar entre la multitud de caminantes y regresar con ayuda. Sin embargo, los susurradores se mueven con cuchillos entre los zombis.

Maggie regresa, para consternación de Negan. Los desafíos que superó desde su partida han hecho que se vuelva difícil sobrevivir para ella y su hijo. Por otro lado, Daryl y Maggie luchan inesperadamente contra una amenaza invisible y desconocida.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
AccuWeather "Ask The Experts" goes beyond the forecast to give viewers the how and why about weather, space, and science.

After a stint in prison for his first robbery attempt, during which he is badly abused, Daniel Morgan (Dennis Hopper) swears revenge on those who ruined his life. Like the outlaws of the American West, Morgan, aided by an aborigine sidekick named Billy (David Gulpilil), becomes a folk hero among the Australian people, while those in power begin to worry about the trouble he is stirring up. Soon Mad Dog Morgan is Public Enemy No. 1, but neither he nor Billy intends to go down easily.
A drug-treated schizophrenic (Baird Stafford) plagued by horrible nightmares escapes from the hospital and goes on a killing spree.
Hitler's money man leaves his son (Michael Caine) $4 billion for philanthropy and possibly neo-Nazis.
A former secret agent, Ki-heon, is living in seclusion due to trauma. When he meets a cloned human, Seo Bok, his restless journey begins.
A master swordsman must once again wield his weapon against those who threaten his desire to live in peace.
Gao Haojun, an international security expert, is hijacked by gunmen on the first flight of the A380 airliner, and his blind daughter is one of the undercover hostages, a fact that he doesn't know.

Lee Jeong Hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su A, who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su A becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe.

Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt group of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself as a kung fu master.

Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.
Two troublemaking cops investigate eerie murders and find a link to an aspiring starlet.

Shirley Yang returns to China in search of Professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, but finds him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.
Examining possible evidence of 20th-century alien contact, including a 1942 aerial battle over Los Angeles and reports of a 1947 UFO crash in Roswell, N.M.
An ancient mountaintop fortress in Peru constructed with laser-like tools; temples at Vijayanagara, India harness cosmic energy; an acoustic chamber in Malta enables interplanetary communication.

Historical prophets may have had alien influences; there are some who believe that extraterrestrials have used intermediaries; they were used to transmit important moral, philosophical and artistic codes to humanity.
Questioning how humans learned to heal by exploring ancient possibilities involving the human body, breakthroughs in medicine and medical procedures.
Spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised people throughout history. Exploring the possibility that shamans communicated with extraterrestrials to influence mankind.

Counting down 10 intriguing symbols and codes found across the globe that might contain proof of otherworldly contact; from glyphs in the Peruvian desert, to spiral petroglyphs embedded with advanced math, and a language with an unexplained origin.
Charlie and Kate's sexual episode leads to complications when he innocently asks her to a movie; Sam kisses a girl and the picture winds up on a social media site.
Charlie gets an invitation to his sister's baby shower and asks Kate to come along. Patrick decides to tell Ed that his daughter is gay.
Charlie believes his father is faking Alzheimer's, and uses a hidden camera to spy on him. Patrick offers to help Nolan change his appearance to help his self-esteem.
Charlie begins a questionable romantic relationship with an ex-patient after the five-year mandatory waiting period runs out.
Charlie tries to persuade his father to join a choir of people his own age, a decision he later regrets. Lacey helps Patrick as an anger ally while he deals with a bully from high school.
Jennifer moves in with Charlie temporarily and Kate gets jealous.
Charlie tries to help his patient with a placebo pill that supposedly reduces anger; Jennifer asks Charlie to hang out with Kate.
Charlie gets involved with Sam's English teacher, he thinks her bad grade is based on his poor sexual performance; Lacey starts to have illicit romantic dreams about both Kate and Charlie.
Charlie runs into problems when CeeLo Green hires him as his personal therapist. Kate wants Charlie to drop CeeLo as a patient, because he is interrupting their time together.
Charlie and Kate face off as expert witnesses in the same trial; Charlie gives Nolan homework to get in touch with his feelings.
Martin has Charlie's daughter baptized behind Charlie's back.
Charlie dates Jennifer's business partner and finds out she has sexual anger issues; the support group tries to find a rich boyfriend for Lacey.
Lindsay Lohan comes to Charlie for therapy, and they begin a tumultuous relationship that ends up getting her in trouble.
Charlie's neighbors find out he's been having clients with anger issues meeting at his house; Kate goes with Jennifer to help find a dress for Sam.
When Sam finds out that her favorite horse is in equine therapy, Charlie uses that as a bonding exercise for his group.
Charlie inadvertently puts two patients together in a romantic relationship.
Charlie manages to persuade Kate to take Nolan on as her PA, but Nolan discovers more than Charlie would like to know. Meanwhile, Lacey is having problems in prison.
Charlie lets his father help him coach a high school baseball team; Kate takes over Charlie's group during his coaching gig.
Charlie's ex causes him problems with his group when she becomes one of his patient's life coach; Lacey helps Charlie's dad get a Facebook account.
Martin tells Kate that Charlie and Jennifer are getting back together; Nolan helps Ed as his anger buddy.
Charlie shakes up his relationship with Kate while dealing with the return of Jen's ex-boyfriend; Charlie's group volunteers at a soup kitchen.
Charlie and Kate try to control their sexual urges as they begin work together on their sex study; Lacey starts a new job as a pharmaceutical rep.
After his breakup, Charlie starts a friends-with-benefits relationship with a hot woman subject from the sex study.
Charlie's trip to Lake Tahoe with the group is interrupted when he gets some interesting news from Kate.
Charlie begins seeing a new female therapist who has unorthodox therapy methods; Patrick tricks Ed into thinking he won the lottery.
Charlie steals a hot woman from an angry nerd who finds a way to make his life a living hell; Lacey takes drugs.
Charlie learns a secret about Jen's new boyfriend when he joins his therapy group; Ed moves in with Patrick.
Charlie begins dating a woman, not knowing that her brother is a serial killer from his prison support group.
Charlie suspects Jen's boyfriend is cheating on her with his patient; Ed and Patrick help Nolan after his apartment gets robbed.
Charlie has to deal with the aftermath when his dad moves in with his patient, and they hit someone with their car; Lacey takes Nolan out for a night of clubbing.
Charlie mistakenly becomes a sex surrogate for one of Kate's patients; Jennifer gets upset when Sam gets a tattoo.
Charlie gets jealous of Jennifer's much younger boyfriend; Patrick helps Lacey look sexy for her first modeling gig.
Nick is disappointed when Frank crashes his Father's Day trip. However, when a lift stops, the men are forced to have a meaningful heart-to-heart.
Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay. However, Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from disappointment.
Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.
Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.
Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains. Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.
Marilyn's new boyfriend Paul tries to convince the Kingston-Persons family to buy into a timeshare, but they are really buying into a scam.
When Kevin enters a campaign for class president, Suzanne wants him to run a clean campaign but Terrence, the Karl Rove of school elections, is adamant that he must go negative.
Kevin takes care of a rat that ends up getting lost in the house. Tension arises between Gigi and Lindsey when one of Gigi's old boyfriends showers them with gifts and clothes.
When Nick realises he is the same age his father was when he died, he decides not to waste another minute and starts tackling a list of risky activities to accomplish before he dies.
Nick angers Suzanne when he invites Martin to an exclusive sporting event before inviting his wife.
When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well - a decision they soon regret when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.
When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best holiday ever.

Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect. Unfortunately, Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Nick and Suzanne consider purchasing life insurance as they feel it would be a good decision to protect their family. However, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.
Nick decides the kids need to bond with his mother and asks that they spend time together. Suzanne has a day off, but she does not know what to do, now that she has a lot of time on her hands.
Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event. Lindsey prepares a feast.
When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.
After Kevin watches 'The Sixth Sense', he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.
After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image. But Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.
When Suzanne's stubborn need to argue her point gets her arrested, she starts to change her ways - but not necessarily for the better.
Nick asks Suzanne to help pro baseball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event.
Lindsey is thrilled to get her first job at Up and Down Burger, but when she gives out free food to failed NBA hopeful Terrell, she soon learns the consequences of stealing at the workplace.
Nick helps Kevin with his Valentine's Day at school, but it goes wrong when Kevin gets sent home.
Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.
Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.
Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.
The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they sometimes realise you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.
Mr Peterson announces a new KAWT morning show featuring a reality show star as the co-host, but she threatens Nick and the other anchors' jobs in order to steal the spotlight.
Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon, while Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.
When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank abandoning his own responsibilities.
After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours. To avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.
A bullied girl becomes friends with a new kid during a break, but when classes start up again, their new friendship is nearly ruined when the bullying continues.
The F4 guys have moved on to college while Jan Di has entered her senior year of high school. She has not heard from Jun Pyo since he left.
Jan Di waits to hear the conclusions of F3's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their look that it was not good.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.

After being released from jail, Percy Talbott (Alison Elliott) travels to a town in Maine looking for a new beginning. When she arrives, she finds work at a restaurant owned by the crabby Hannah (Ellen Burstyn). She also befriends a waitress named Shelby (Marcia Gay Harden) and begins a romance with an attractive local named Joe (Kieran Mulroney). But when Hannah falls ill and Percy plans to help her sell the restaurant, Shelby's husband (Will Patton) becomes suspicious of her intentions.

Impressed by high school student David's (Tobey Maguire) devotion to a 1950s family TV show, a mysterious television repairman (Don Knotts) provides him with a means to escape into the black-and-white program with his sister, Jennifer (Reese Witherspoon). While David initially takes to the simplistic, corny world of the show, Jennifer sets about jolting the characters with doses of reality that unexpectedly bring a little color into their drab existence.

Vinnie Antonelli (Steve Martin) trades the mob for the witness protection program and moves to a small suburb in California. But for Vinnie, old ways die hard. He becomes a challenge for Barney Coopersmith (Rick Moranis), the FBI agent in charge of making sure Vinnie keeps a low profile before he can testify against his former mob associates. Barney, though, might actually be able to learn some things from Vinnie. That is, if Barney can keep him alive long enough.

Former sportswriter Andy Farmer and his secretly aspiring author wife, Elizabeth, move to a small farm in Vermont, so Andy can focus on writing a novel. They quickly realize that the locals are not as welcoming as they'd like and that the farm is more distracting than inspiring. Having trouble with his manuscript, and with his marriage on the rocks, Andy is forced to take hilariously drastic measures in an attempt to get his life back on track.

Dylan Ramsey (David Spade) is getting ready to open his own restaurant, but he's become preoccupied his new neighbor, a gorgeous Frenchwoman named Lila (Sophie Marceau). When Dylan doesn't have much luck talking to her, he decides that the way to her heart may be through her beloved dog, Jack. Abducting the canine, Dylan hopes to win Lila's affection when he returns Jack safe and sound, but soon the scheming guy has to deal with numerous unforeseen problems that jeopardize his plan.
A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

When a sheik (Jamie Farr) decides to sponsor a cross-country race in hope of winning, racer J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds) enters the competition along with his friend Victor (Dom DeLuise). They aspire to claim the $1 million prize and pick up two women on the way. Meanwhile, the sheik helps Jamie Blake (Dean Martin) and Morris Fenderbaum (Sammy Davis Jr.) with an angry mob boss. But when the sheik is kidnapped, the contestants must come together to help him.

Jonathan se encuentra con Sara, una joven cantante que desea saber más sobre su madre muerta, pero a su padre no le gusta hablar de ella. Sin embargo, la vida de Sara puede cambiar cuando un secreto sale a la luz.
Un atleta llamado Dick queda postrado en una silla de ruedas luego de un terrible accidente. El joven necesita la ayuda de Mark y Jonathan, pero también de Eleanor.

Gracias a la ayuda de Jonathan, un estudiante de secundaria que queda postrado luego de un accidente recupera su voluntad de vivir. Sin embargo, su furia reaparece cuando descubre que el hombre que lo atropelló está más cerca de lo que cree.
Un anciano excéntrico que dice ser el Rey Arturo y su codicioso hijo reciben la ayuda de Jonathan y Mark. Además, asisten a una mujer que va a perder sus tierras por culpa del ambicioso heredero.
Un famoso actor contrata a Jonathan y a Mark para que cuiden a sus dos hijos. Sin embargo, los niños sienten mucho la ausencia de su padre.
Jonathan y Mark acuden al llamado de un par de ancianos que buscan la ayuda de un ángel para poder hacer una película que llegue al corazón de muchas personas.

Un hombre que estuvo en Vietnam descubre que tiene una hija llamada Nu Yen, que decide irse a vivir a Estados Unidos con él y su familia. Su hijo Brad es la única persona que no está contenta con esta situación, por lo que Jonathan y Mark le ayudan.

Mark y Jonathan ayudan a Barry, un heredero que debe hacerse cargo del hotel de su padre. Al mismo tiempo, debe decidir entre dos mujeres que lo desean: una antigua compañera de clase, y una mujer que trabaja en el hotel.

La expansión de un negocio de autos amenaza a un orfanato justo en plena Navidad. Jonathan y Mark deben hacer comprender al dueño del negocio cuál es el significado de estas fiestas para que no lleve a cabo sus planes.
Jonathan y Mark van a una cafetería para desayunar y son molestados por ser forasteros. Ambos investigan la desaparición de un viejo amigo de Mark. Jonathan encuentra el auto de Charly enterrado.

Jonathan conoce a Liby, de la que se termina enamorando. Al mismo tiempo, Earl, otro chico interesado en Liby, lleva tiempo tratando de conquistarla, por lo que Jonathan debe tomar una decisión difícil.
Mark tiene un accidente automovilístico y queda herido. Jonathan, entonces, lo hace viajar en el tiempo para que pueda salvar a su abuelo y recuperar las tierras de su familia.
Una estrella de baloncesto de la universidad lucha diariamente con su analfabetismo para poder lograr ser becado. Sin embargo, una enfermedad del corazón le impide llevar a cabo sus sueños.
Una mujer moribunda intenta reconciliarse con su severo padre para que su hija ilegítima pueda vivir en un lugar seguro.

It's a life or death situation in Reading, Penn., when a rideshare driver picks up a very dangerous passenger; chaos ensues in Illinois when tempers flare in an explosive showdown between an enraged trucker and dozens of motorcyclists.

Florida motorcyclists fight with an angry driver and find themselves staring down the barrel of a gun; a semitruck is no match for high-speed winds from a tornado; an elderly woman appears to be taking her motorized scooter cross-country.

Two drivers in Florida play a dangerous game of cat and mouse; a couple's shortcut in Canada causes their truck to plummet into an icy lake; an RV engulfed in flames rolls down a Philadelphia street; two men pursue thieves in California.

An impatient SUV driver in Oregon attacks a cyclist at a red light and gets serious comeuppance; a congressional candidate threatens an officer's job when she pulls him over for speeding and texting while driving.

A distracted police officer in Missouri strikes a bicyclist with his vehicle; a woman is caught red-handed keying another person's car in Louisiana; a motorcyclist crashes into a ditch after being sideswiped by a jeep in Illinois.

Professional photographers become the victims of a broad daylight smash and grab in San Francisco; in San Diego, an enraged dog walker goes ballistic when she confronts a speeding driver in her neighborhood.

A man in Texas is pursued by an angry driver wielding a finger gun; a driver raging at two women in California is intercepted by two men who send him packing; a ride-share driver in Texas has food thrown in her face by an unruly passenger.
Two men attempt a carjacking at a car wash; a hapless teenage driver turns a parking lot into a demolition derby and more.
A disagreement over driving rules in a Washington State parking lot ends with multiple gunshots; a confrontational driver pushes two friends to the brink.

Deonte Prince se pregunta si es cierto que su novia sale con amigas. Riyah Evans le descubre una mentira a su novio.
Lisa Goodman descubre que la ex de su marido ahora es la otra. J'zon Warner se entera de qué tipo de lazos mantiene su prometida con su familia.

Natasha se entera de que las reuniones fuera del horario de su marido, no siempre están relacionadas con el trabajo; Krystal descubre que su novio ha estado experimentando con las leyes de la atracción.
Crystal descubre que su novio todavía vive la vida de soltero; Monique nota que su novio puede haber encontrado a alguien nuevo.
Haley descubre que su novio ha desarrollado una atracción fatal; Kari se encuentra con la otra vida que lleva su novio cuando está lejos.
Sarah descubre la identidad de su esposo; William persigue a su esposa para revelar la verdad.
Lacey descubre que su prometido todavía quiere festejar; Ebony tiene un problema con las expediciones de pesca de su novio.
Roxy Salazar descubre que su prometido quiere mucho a su cuñada. Sharonda Epps recuerda que las cosas se devuelven.
Chelo descubre los gajes que su novio obtiene en el trabajo; Teresa encuentra a su novio jugando con una hembra seductora.

Jeffrey, quien dejó su empleo para cuidar a los niños, descubre lo que hace realmente su esposa cuando, en teoría, está trabajando por la noche. Irene averigua el verdadero motivo por el que a su esposo le gusta tanto ir al gimnasio ahora.
Robert Gaimon descubre que su novia está haciendo de maestra de educación sexual con un alumno muy atento. Yolanda Daniels se entera de que a su novio le gusta rellenar más que panes.
Toby descubre que su novia está embarazada; Niecy averigua que su novio está mintiendo sobre su relación.
Susan se entera del fetiche de su esposo. Shay encuentra a su novio endulzándole el oído a otra.
Alan Ingles se entera de que su novia quiere a otro. Amber Avery descubre el verdadero motivo por el que su pareja quiso vivir por su cuenta.
Jennifer se entera de que su novio es un estafador. Tiera descubre qué tipo de entrenamientos hace su novio.
Sara descubre que su novio ayuda a una nueva vecina; novio de Keon está engañándola en el trabajo.
Erin descubre dónde va su marido para las fiestas; Faye se da cuenta de que su novio lleva el club a casa con él.
Un hombre que asiste a una feria local con su familia termina ganando una casa, pero, al inspeccionar el lugar, descubre que una mujer y su madre ya viven allí.

Salvador siempre ha resuelto sus problemas por medio del engaño y la trampa. Pero esta vez se metió con un mafioso y su vida entera depende del éxito de Gasparotto, un futbolista con la rodilla lastimada.
El Caudillo no se detiene ante nada en su búsqueda por el poder, valiéndose de la corrupción, la amenaza y el asesinato.
Elena y su amiga Laura, dos chicas atractivas, harán todo lo posible para atraer y retener a un mafioso muy rico.
El refrán que un hombre solía decir, "hasta para morir hay que saber hacerlo", lo convirtió en leyenda.

Charly al quedar huérfano tiene que robar para sobrevivir y se refugia en un gimnasio de boxeo donde se encarga de la limpieza a cambio de comida entrenando en sus ratos libres. Ahora luchará por alcanzar su sueño de disputar un campeonato.
Un traficante de drogas de poca monta y su novia prostituta se topan con la oportunidad de sus vidas.

Annie está embarazada y, durante la ausencia de su esposo, se queda con su amiga Brenda, que es doctora. La suegra de Annie es una partera que discute con Brenda para determinar la mejor opción para Annie, si los remedios caseros o científicos.
Un hombre utiliza métodos de películas de comedia romántica para tratar de recuperar a su exnovia.
Dispuesto a hacer justicia por el asesinato de su madre, un mercenario se propone encontrar al padre que nunca conoció.
Después de diez años, un grupo de amigos de la secundaria se reúne para desenterrar una cápsula del tiempo.
Al quedarse repentinamente sin trabajo, una mujer toma una posición como niñera para un guapo padre adoptivo.
Una joven mujer y su indiferente padre deben trabajar juntos para salvar el rancho de ganado de su abuelo fallecido.
Una mujer (Julie Benz) de negocios conoce a un famoso chef (Scott Elrod) y a su familia (JoBeth Williams, Elliott Gould) mientras visita unos viñedos en California.
Los fantasmas de las Navidades pasadas, presentes y futuras visitan a una desagradable presentadora televisión y le dan la oportunidad de encontrar algo genuino en el espíritu navideño.
Ellie y Martín son dos recién casados que han perdido sus respectivos trabajos y tienen que irse a vivir a casa de los padres de ella.

Un hombre solitario y reprimido sexualmente ve con ojos libidinosos a su vecina, hasta el punto de secuestrarla y encerrarla en un sótano, donde la someterá a toda clase de martirios, buscando que de alguna manera se enamore de él.

Clara trabajaba como asistente de Norman, un escritor. Diez años después, las personas más cercanas de Clara empiezan a morir, una tras otra. Clara está segura de que Norman es el culpable de todo, pero, ¿cómo demostrarlo?

Juanjo, Mario y Lucía viajan a una comunidad Qom en el Impenetrable, un bosque profundo en el norte de Argentina, para realizar un documental que muestre la miseria y la desolación en la que vive el pueblo aborigen, sin imaginar lo que les espera.

El agente Ramírez investiga la constante aparición de cadáveres en callejones de la ciudad. Aunque parezca una locura, todo parece indicar que un vampiro recorre la urbe por la noche, en busca de víctimas o quién sabe qué más.

El cambio climático ha provocado la necesidad de emplear oxígeno artificial para poder respirar. Con su mujer enferma y pocas esperanzas de sobrevivir, Ethan se ve obligado a viajar al futuro para salvar a los humanos.
Tras lograr erradicar la letal pandemia del virus de 2067, la humanidad vive una época de paz y prosperidad. Sin embargo, una sombra se cierne sobre las comunidades de supervivientes.
Ellos crecieron en extrema pobreza, pero sus vidas tomaron rumbos diferentes. Una huella de la infancia marca sus destinos de manera implacable.

Lorenzo siempre soñó con ser guapo y gracias a un conjuro su deseo se hizo realidad. Pronto descubrirá que ser tan agraciado no es fácil y justo en el momento que todo es una hermosura, una bella mujer se enamora de él, pero del lado feo.
Aurelia vio a su madre morir. Desde entonces, quiere vengarse de los asesinos.
Gangsters and vampires collide in a gory battle.

When a man reaches out to his sister with surveillance footage of a murder in their hometown, she reluctantly returns to help him investigate. She soon uncovers a disturbing secret that's tied to a decades-old supernatural phenomenon.
Hired to steal a rare VHS tape from a remote house, a ragtag band of crooks finds a dead body, old TVs and a lot of cryptic footage.
As they search for clues to the whereabouts of a missing student, a couple view the ghastly stories recorded on a collection of videotapes.

A police chase through the streets of Los Angeles inspires dozens of fame-obsessed teens to try to capture the salacious footage, but they are unaware that they will face their own deaths as stars of the next video sensation.
A British film censor links a disturbing horror movie to her sister's mysterious disappearance.
A modern-day psychic using occult practices to communicate with the dead experiences an evil beyond human comprehension.
Terror strikes when a former soldier takes a job to help a young woman and her housebound mother.
A remote village in Egypt explodes into spiritual warfare when a carpenter, his wife and their son Jesus are targeted by supernatural forces.

El Día de Muertos es ya bien conocido por los habitantes de la República Mexicana, por eso, en este documental se busca la intimidad familiar de quienes celebran y mantienen esta tradición. Las familias partícipes, la preparación de los alimentos, la ofrenda, la banda de música del pueblo, el panteón lleno de flores, que lo convierte, una vez al año en la celebración a la vida de quienes pasaron por aquí.
Se resuelven los misterios de distintos oficios y profesiones a través de entrevistas y cápsulas especiales con expertos, todo de manera.
