When a British TV show becomes popular, an American network often makes its own version of the show. In this case, Lifetime is importing this series that pits four amateur cooks against one another as they compete for a cash prize. Each contestant prepares a meal for a dinner party -- with a unique theme, location and menu -- for the other competitors, who critique and score the cook. The contestant who earns the most points for his or her party wins the title of the host with the most and, more importantly, the money. Radio personality Todd Pettengill narrates the series.
The queen of cooking, Lianne, is up against Lee's Rat Pack-themed evening.
The differences between two contestants lead to some entertaining exchanges around the table.
Office manager Julie serves her guests some hearty comfort food to win them over; however, not all the dishes impress.
Gail sets out to impress with some gourmet dining; to her, the color-matched cutlery and placemats are just as important as the meal -- however, her guests don't feel the same.
Surfer Ben welcomes guests to his beachside apartment for a relaxed dining atmosphere with the theme of Australiana.
Jennifer hosts a Mexicana-themed dinner party as a tribute to her birth land; she makes a very hot salsa that leaves her guests in tears.
Former pop-star Richard cooks up a hearty English meal; however, his dinner party may not impress enough to win the prize.
Trudi hosts the first night's dinner party and reveals her cooking oil spray obsession while working her way through the food prep.
Luke's job at the family business helps him to get a bit of a head start in prepping the night's dinner party; the guests are divided on whether Luke's entertainment or food was best.
Anne-Maree feels intimidated to host the night's party because she views herself as the "poor cousin" of the group.
The ambitious Angela attempts a Hollywood-themed dinner party featuring offal; however, she may have bitten off more than she can chew.
Alex is hoping to host a popular dinner party for the last night of the week; also, the week's winner will be revealed.
Student Rachel hopes to impress with her American diner theme.
Lady of leisure Jill, 49, is hoping to wow with an Italian menu.
Cabin crew Mark hopes to impress with fine dining.
Parole officer Bernard offers Northern Soul and grub.
Health assistant Lisa banks on her no-faff menu to bag the cash.

In Manchester, former fashion model Alex Leigh serves a Chinese-inspired menu that causes confusion with her dinner guests with a choice of two not especially Chinese desserts, bread and butter pudding and banoffee pie.
Latoya wants to know if Tony is her biological father; Cole and his mom return to the show with an update on what life has been like since going to rehab for his addiction.
A woman spends the better part of two decades trying to solve a DNA mystery; a woman thinks she may be running out of patience with her boyfriend's infidelity and toxic behavior.
Jalen and Olivia have been together since college; now Jalen believes Olivia is cheating; Theara wants to know why Eric goes away in the middle of the night for hours.
Quandra says that her sister Deidra's fiancé, Jamar, is a cheating and manipulative liar; Andrea believes that her daughter Ruby has crossed over to the dark side and is a devil worshiper.
Eric says his 14-year-old sister is out of control and headed down the path of self-destruction; Lesley is convinced that his wife is cheating on him.

Shawntia has more than $13,000 worth of debt because of her husband Ian's gambling obsession; Mercedes is pregnant and all alone after kicking her husband, Haywood, out of the house because, during an argument, she says, he bit her.
Dytazia wants to know if her mother tried to sell her for drugs; a young boy dies while in the care of a relative; Kristie wants to know who her biological father is.

Marshall and his wife find out if he has a daughter; Keonie is fed up with being fat-shamed and controlled by his verbally abusive grandmother, who says that she's always had his back and did everything she could to raise him.
Aaliyah had to put Daijon on probation when she found out that he was cheating with strippers; Jael is ready to confront her mother after years of physical and emotional abuse.

Sisters Jazmine, Jenny and Janey hope they can repair the scar tissue from some very deep wounds; Rani is livid and can't seem to get the image of her boyfriend, Chris, with another woman out of her mind.

Brandon believes that wife Tiffany is cheating on him with several men; Mark raised Markeya and her siblings as if they were his own, but after their grandmother passed away, he noticed a change for the worse in their behavior toward him.

Best friends planned to move in together, then Fredo inexplicably ghosted Cassie and deleted her from social media; alcoholic Kelly has been sober for years and wants to repair things with her son, but he resents her for choosing the bottle over him.

Anita's daughters believe that she was responsible for their father's death; Ginai admits that she hangs out around best friend Kiki's dad, but says she would never cross the line of sleeping with him.

Derisha confronts her son's father, who refuses to spend time with him and wants a DNA test; Chris is desperate to mend fences with his teen daughter who is struggling with her transition and the breakup of her parents.

Sylvia fears that her boyfriend may be cheating with their provocatively dressed housemate, Santa; while Adrianne admits to abandoning daughter Deekah in the past, she says gone above and beyond to repair things with her and wants to see her again.

The toxicity in Rebecca and Jake's relationship might be too much to overcome; Tia says a drunken fistfight ended her friendship with Dionne four years ago, and she hopes that Karamo can help restore it.

Lashoun got daughter Jelisha involved in a lingerie basketball league, but this isn't the path Jelisha wants to pursue; Roselee has been cashing in on her fame on social media but says Jeremiah is having a hard time accepting she's the breadwinner.
Carlos is suspected of murdering a reporter he slept with the night before her death, and Kiera learns first-hand the lengths to which a person will go to get elected.
Kiera and Brad's trust reaches a breaking point; Carlos and Kellog come to their own realizations; Alec has a strange encounter.
Kiera and Carlos visit Roland's farm to investigate a recent bulk purchase of ammonium nitrate, which could be used to make a bomb, but events spiral out of control.
Kiera investigates the mysterious disappearance of several deceased time traveler's bodies; Alec is taken hostage by Garza on orders from his future self.

Detective Kiera Cameron is a cop from the year 2077 who was raised to rely on technology more than anything else, even herself. Now she and a group of deadly criminals called Liber8 are trapped in present-day Vancouver. Cameron needs to stop Liber8 before it can take down the corporations which will one day rule the world -- thus altering the course of the future and changing the 2077 that Cameron calls home. She enlists the help of a teenage tech genius named Alec Sadler to help figure out a way to get her back to her own time, and she manages to work with the Vancouver Police Department with Detective Carlos Fonnegra to keep an eye on Liber8. With different ideals and backgrounds, Cameron and Fonnegra clash, but they trust each other, and Cameron is slowly learning to trust herself as well.
Kiera and Carlos's reunion is a bumpy one as they attempt to thwart Liber8's brazen hijacking of a prison transfer; Kellog approaches Alec with a partnership proposition.
City Protective Services officer Kiera Cameron is transported from 2077 to deal with eight of the world's deadliest terrorists.
Kiera looks into the two Alecs in one timeline; the mayor is kidnapped; and Carlos struggles with Kiera's predicament.
Kiera crash lands her CPS flyer during a prisoner transport in 2076 and is forced to work with her enemy captive in order to survive.
The boss of a major corporation is kidnapped and Kagame puts the victim's fate in the hands of the public, with an Internet poll determining whether she should be freed or killed.

Un joven huye a toda velocidad para evadir a la policía porque está bajo libertad condicional. Sin embargo, provoca que le pongan nuevos cargos e irá a la cárcel. Unos chicos son detenidos por posesión de fármacos controlados y variedad de drogas.
En una persecución nocturna, los oficiales interceptan a un conductor que huye a toda velocidad. La tensión crece cuando descubren sustancias ilegales y un pasajero nervioso complica la detención.

Una llamada por un disturbio doméstico lleva a los agentes a mediar en una discusión que escala rápidamente. Entre versiones cruzadas y emociones intensas, deben decidir cómo proteger a los involucrados.
Un sospechoso corre entre callejones tras ser señalado por robo. Cámaras corporales captan la carrera y el momento exacto en que los oficiales logran alcanzarlo y esclarecer lo ocurrido.
Lo que parece una revisión vehicular ordinaria revela órdenes pendientes y objetos sospechosos. Los oficiales mantienen la calma mientras desentrañan una situación inesperada.
En un turno agitado, reportes de alteración del orden llevan a varias intervenciones consecutivas. Cada encuentro muestra el lado humano y desafiante del trabajo policial.
Una denuncia por comportamiento errático activa un operativo inmediato. Los oficiales deben evaluar riesgos y actuar con rapidez para evitar que la situación termine en tragedia.

La policía intenta detener a un hombre sospechoso en bicicleta, pero huye, lo que provoca que lo arresten. Un hombre en libertad condicional es detenido por pasarse un alto, y la policía encuentra droga y una bala, así que deberá volver a la cárcel.

Un hombre sospechoso se ve involucrado en una persecución para escapar de la policía porque tiene órdenes de arresto. Unos chicos son detenidos por conducir en contraflujo, pero la policía percibe un fuerte olor a marihuana en el auto.

Un oficial del condado encuentra una camioneta que ha sido reportada como robada en una gasolinera. Sin embargo, descubre que solo ha sido un cambio de placas, lo que es ilegal, por lo que el conductor es multado y se libra de ir a la cárcel.

En un vecindario se presenta una operación policíaca para atrapar a un sospechoso que escapa entres las casas. Con la ayuda de un dron y un perro policía logran capturarlo. Investigan un auto sospechoso con una chica que consume drogas.

La policía atiende el caso sobre una camioneta que fue reportada como robada e interceptan a un hombre que asegura ser inocente. Después de una peligrosa persecución, la policía detiene a un hombre por evasión a la autoridad y posesión de droga.

Un hombre es detenido por traer los vidrios polarizados del coche, la policía descubre que tiene órdenes de arresto por posesión de droga y encuentran más sustancias en el coche. El oficial solo lo multa y le ofrece ayuda para superar la adicción.

La policía persigue un auto reportado como robado y descubre que el conductor está armado. Por lo que, lo arrestan por ambos delitos, posesión de auto robado y una arma cargada sin tener permiso para portarla.

Una oficial de policía detiene un auto por violar el código vehicular y descubre a una pareja con actitud sospechosa: además de no tener identificación poseen varias drogas en el auto. La policía impone la multa y les recomienda dejar las adicciones.

Un oficial encuentra a un joven que conoce que está en libertad condicional junto con otro hombre, a quien investigan y resulta ser un delincuente con varios cargos y posesión de sustancias controladas.

La policía intercepta a un hombre sospechoso que está estacionado en un parque, el cual se molesta al ser interrogado y confiesa tener drogas en el auto. Dos hombres son detenidos por posesión de drogas, quienes niegan ser los propietarios.

Un hombre con una orden de arresto intenta escapar de la policía. Durante la persecución provoca destrozos a su paso y pone en peligro a su prometida, por lo que se le asignan más cargos y es llevado a la cárcel.

La policía atiende un robo por bicicleta y persigue a un hombre, que al ser interrogado se comporta de forma agresiva. Se realiza un operativo para atrapar al vendedor unas pelotas de béisbol robadas.

La policía detiene a una pareja por una infracción vehicular, pero el hombre huye sin razón, así que va a la cárcel por evadir a la autoridad. Por otro lado, un oficial atiende un caso por un auto robado.

Un oficial de policía detiene a una pareja y descubre un olor fuerte a marihuana en el auto, el pasajero escapa por llevar una bolsa llena de hierba y confiesa que es para venta. Una mujer es reportada por robar varias veces mercancía de una tienda.

Un hombre es reportado por estar corriendo en la calle agitando una arma y la policía deduce que su comportamiento es por un consumo excesivo de marihuana. La policía detiene a un auto que sale de un hotel conocido por venta de narcóticos.

La policía, con la ayuda de la unidad canina, atiende un intento de robo. Un hombre entra a la fuerza a la casa de su madre porque quiere quitarse la vida y ahí tiene armas. Un hombre es arrestado por robar una camioneta e inventa una historia para justificarse.

El reto consiste en cocinar con lo básico, al vapor, hervido o escalfado, cada participante debe preparar una proteína y hacer un platillo espectacular. En el servicio de este capítulo servirán sashimi en la mesa.

Megan moves across the country to rebuild her life. When she runs into one of her former colleagues, she is pleasantly surprised and the pair become close friends. When he wants more from her, he begins sabotaging everything in Megan's life.

Carter receives a collect call from Vinnie, and a dark event from the past threatens to destroy his current success. Once a good friend of Carter's, Vinnie is now a deluded barfly living in a small town in California. He has gotten himself into trouble and calls Carter to bail him out before the truth about their past - their involvement in a horse racing scam which resulted in the ruin of an innocent man - comes to light.
A U.S. judge (Martin Sheen) tries the touchy case of an East German couple who have hijacked a plane to West Berlin.
John Watkins, Canada's ambassador to Moscow, is suspected of being a communist spy. Based on a true story.
A businessman goes into hiding after his assistant is killed.
Either the Task Force or her sister's boyfriend may have kidnapped a hard-working woman; meanwhile, Frost's house burns down.
A late-night stabbing in a car near a football pitch.
A disrespected but decent British detective unravels a cold case about a missing seventeen-year-old girl while trying to deal with the breakup of his marriage.
A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.
An actress (Samantha Eggar) escapes from an asylum to attend her husband's (John Vernon) casting session for starlets.

Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

A writer and his secret lover spend time at a remote cabin in the Appalachian Mountains to work on a horror novel. They learn several boys have gone missing, and after the writer's lover also disappears, he tries to solve the mystery.

Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.
A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

Jonathan y Mark buscan trabajo como entrenadores de boxeo para poder ayudar a jóvenes llenos de ira. Mientras tanto, reaparece Morton Clay, también conocido como "el jinete enmascarado", acompañado de sus amigos.
El ex de Louisa regresa a Portwenn esperando una reunión; Martin ve a un paciente que tiene una historia de autolesión; la prima de Elaine, Pauline, toma un trabajo en la cirugía.
Luisa es considerada para promoción como directora de la escuela, pero Martín está en el Consejo Superior y puede ir en contra de ella.

El Doctor Martín visita a los hermanos Flint en el caserío que comparten con sus padres. Wallace y Paddy han estado sufriendo trastornos estomacales crónicos, y un análisis de sangre confirma que tienen intoxicación por salmonela.

Los equipos deben identificar el tipo de proteína es usada en cinco platos; el equipo ganador disfruta su victoria en una casa de playa, los perdedores deben moler granos para preparar pan desde cero; los concursantes son puestos en la parrilla.
Ramsay toma una decisión que cambia la competición, dos chefs trabajan como servidores durante el servicio de la cena, cada equipo nomina a dos concursantes para ponerlos en la eliminación.
El Chef Martín Yan juzga seis platos chinos creados por los concursantes restantes; durante el servicio de la cena, un equipo decepciona un invitado VIP; un concursante es eliminado.

Los concursantes entran a un corral de animales para determinar qué tipo de proteína se cocinará en el desafío de equipo; durante el servicio de la cena, los concursantes deben impresionar a los familiares del chef Ramsay.
Los equipos deben crear cinco platos de carne; un comensal encuentra una desagradable sorpresa en su plato durante la cena; la ronda eliminatoria trae malos humores.
A punto de jubilarse, la inspectora jefe Jane Tennison debe investigar el brutal asesinato de una chica de 14 años, mientras enfrenta sus problemas de alcoholismo y la muerte de su padre.
Jane Tennison regresa a Southampton Row para dirigir una investigación sobre el asesinato de un niño pequeño.
Barnaby y Winter usan un cómic para encontrar al asesino de una ex-supermodelo durante el festival de cómics de Carver Valley.
A first date becomes part of a deadly criminal trap.
A teenager's online romance ends in tragedy.
A group convicted of attempted murder of Donna's husband, Dean Duggins; three friends plead guilty of the murder of a woman.
Three women reveal how the things they did for love landed them in prison.
A husband's murder results in a life sentence and a conspiracy killing.
Three women find themselves tangled in love triangles where the odd person out ends up murdered.
A double murder case ends in a confession; CCTV exposes a jealous former partner.
An abandoned car is found with four bodies inside; in the UK, a woman is murdered by her stalker.
In the United States, a man desperately calls the police for help after he is attacked.
Shreves was convicted of the 1986 murder of Tony Martinez, her son-in-law; Latham pled guilty to kidnapping a baby from a maternity ward.
A financially strapped Deborah Pierenger is jailed for the murder of her parents.
Two lady criminals lure men to their hotel rooms and rob them at gunpoint; a family follows a mother's command to kill her husband.
Jennifer Faith fabricates a life of abuse to convince a veteran to murder her husband in broad daylight.
For six months, Marcia Eubank lives alongside the remains of her husband whom she has callously murdered.

John Wayne Gacy murdered 33 boys and young men during a six-year period in the 1970s; he was well-liked in the community he lived in and would often dress up for kids' parties, earning himself the nickname Killer Clown.
An outlaw will surrender if his sweetheart gets the reward.
An old enemy of Marshal Micah Torrance's arrives in town, bent on revenge.
A marshal from another territory comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man.
An escaped killer barricades himself and his two companions in the North Fork general store.
Mark meets a stranger whom Lucas suspects of being a wanted man.
A young man wants an education despite his uncle's objection.
The young son of a neighboring rancher is seriously hurt in an accident.
The North Fork schoolteacher is pressured to leave town because of her progressive ideas.
A hired gunman arrives in town to kill a man Lucas has hated for years.
Lucas gives his blood to save a dying man.
Mark's finding of the body of a murder victim starts Lucas, his friend Artemus and Marshal Torrance on a search for the killer.
A criminal threatens to harm Mark unless Lucas sells him the ranch.
A young man takes over the duties of the sheriff, who is out of town.
Lucas and Mark are robbed while riding the stage back from a cattle sale.
Lucas suspects a nobleman, recently arrived from England, of cattle rustling.
An Argentine family moves to North Fork and settles on a ranch adjoining Lucas'.
Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax when they adopt a horse.
Outlaws hunt a retired gunfighter who has settled in North Fork.
Lucas' old friend, a traveling photographer, is accused of murder.
A young couple traveling in a wagon train causes trouble for all of North Fork.
A smart-aleck boy from Brooklyn comes west to seek his fortune.
A U.S. marshal arrives in North Fork, taking an Indian prisoner back east for trial.
A woman whom Lucas remembers as a card cheat opens a boardinghouse in town.
Lucas risks his life when he offers to appear as a witness in a murder trial.
Lucas' old friend arrives for an unexpected visit.

College dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher), together with his friend, technical whiz-kid Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad), sparks a revolution in home computers with the invention of the Apple 1 in 1976. Built in the garage of Jobs' parents, the device -- and the subsequent formation of Apple Inc. -- have changed the world for all time. Though he is viewed as a visionary, Jobs' tenure as Apple's leader is a rocky one, leading to his eventual ouster from the company he co-founded.
A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story.
A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

When ambitious boxer Alain LeFevre refuses to accept a mobster's bribe, he ends up with a price on his head. A marked man, LeFevre takes refuge by enlisting in the French Foreign Legion. After traveling to a remote Moroccan outpost, LeFevre and his regiment suffer repeated attacks at the hands of the Berber rebel army. As he struggles to survive his tenure as a legionnaire, LeFevre dreams of returning to France to find his lady love, Katrina.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

Self-made millionaire Jonathan and freelance writer Jennifer are the Harts - a globetrotting married couple with a talent for finding mysteries wherever they go. And even when they're uncovering thefts, espionage and assorted skullduggery, they still find time for romance.
J.J., an aspiring artist, is discovered by a man who wants to become his patron.
The probability of J.J. not being promoted to a high-school senior worries the whole family.
An angry Housing Authority official visits the Evans family after one of Michael's letters to the editor is published.
Lamont objects to Fred's plan to propose marriage to widowed Donna Harris.
Fred's lifestyle is disrupted when Lamont runs for state assemblyman.
Fred, Grady and Bubba become contestants on a television game show, hoping to win a birthday present for Lamont.
Fred buys half ownership of a professional fighter who can't fight.
Fred awaits a visit from his sister until he finds out that her new husband is white.
Hoffs and Penhall investigate a pregnant coed's unjust accusation that Ioki is her baby's father.
Fuller sends Hanson and Hoffs to defuse an explosive situation in a high school divided by racial tensions; guest J.A. Preston.

Detective Sgt. Rick Hunter fights crime in the San Diego area. The wily homicide investigator isn't afraid to break the rules as he pursues justice, though the perpetrators he and his partners are after frequently end up dead. Criticized for its graphic violence, the show also features witty banter between Hunter and his partner.

Jim Rockford is an ex-con and private detective. He was falsely convicted of a crime he didn't commit, but that doesn't stop him from using his ex-con buddies to help him solve crimes. Nothing comes easy for Rockford, but he works hard and usually gets shot at or beat up at least once per episode.
A gang of young Cherokees steals artifacts from museums, claiming they were taken from ancient burial grounds.
Chico Kwasi faces Teodor Hristov for the GLORY Welterweight World Championship at RTM Stage Rotterdam in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
GLORY Collision 9 is headlined by a Heavyweight World Championship clash as Mory Kromah makes the first defense of his title against Milos Cvjeticanin in a 5-round world title fight.
Trev Gowdy hunts down the prehistoric monster-sized ling cod in Alaska's Cook Islands.
Fred Lavitman goes after bluefin tuna in the treacherous waters of Georges Bank.
Trev hunts down monster king salmon on Alaska's Kenai River; the kings test his tackle to the max.
Carter gets to explore deep in the backwaters on Florida's Nature Coast.
Carter is back in Crystal River for the shallow water grouper fishery.

Baja is one of those magical fisheries that some people just can't get enough of, and Carter Andrews is one of those people; this time around, though, Carter and Julio Meza explore the grouper fishery in the upper Sea of Cortez.
In all the times Carter has visited Baja with Julio, he has seen some amazing fisheries, but the one thing he has yet to explore is Julio's hometown fishery and his farm.
The annual Navajo Nation Elk Hunt! Michael Waddell and friend Ike Rainey break out some Hornady ammunition hunting with Team Yellow Horse; this hunt was over on the first morning!
Bow hunting Elk in New Mexico with our new friend Ike Rainey; this is one of the most unbelievable Elk ranches the team has ever seen! Nick Mundt, Michael Waddell.
Elk Season continues in New Mexico on the Circle R Ranch; Nick Mundt tagged out last week on the first day of the hunt with his Hoyt, and now Michael Waddell is up.

Ike Rainey is the new proud owner of the Legendary Gile's Island; Gile's Island is in the middle of the Mississippi River and is known for its Southern world-class whitetail hunting; Michael Waddell, Nick Mundt, Blake Shelton and Eric Dunn.
Jim and Corey split up and search for buffalo; Jim, unable to reach Corey by radio, hears several shots from Corey's direction and heads out to search for his friend.
Jim and Corey search for an epic hunting spot deep in the coastal rain forest of Vancouver Island that Jim last explored 20 years ago.
Jim hunts whitetails and javelina in south Texas with his daughter Eva.
Following three different whitetail hunts in Saskatchewan, Canada.
Hunting exotics with Irvin Barnahart in Texas.
In pursuit of Persian goitered gazelle and Esfahan sheep.
Host Joe Mantegna joins SIG Sauer to discover the replacement for the workhorse M4 carbine; SIG Sauer's M7's aim is to overcome the limitations of the 5.56 and 7.62 NATO rounds.

Select fire handguns might have limited capacity and application but are still exhilarating to shoot. Join host, Joe Mantegna as he looks back at some of the most exciting and interesting full auto pistols in firearms history.

2024 marks the 80th anniversary of D-Day and Cabot Guns has set out to commemorate it with a very special pistol. Watch as Cabot Guns builds a one of kind Damascus steel 1911 using scraps of metal that survived WWII and the Normandy Invasion.

Come along as we look back at the short-lived US service of the Krag Jorgensen. Used briefly in the Spanish-American War by Teddy Roosevelt's Rough Riders, it quickly became obsolete in the ever-changing landscape of firearms development.
Sunrise gives life to the valley and animals are on the move.
Chris and Casey Keefer are back in the Saskatchewan bushland to test their survival skills.
With base camp set up and the cold setting in, Chris and Casey must find food fast.

Unsuspecting members of the public climbing into an apparently normal taxicab, only to find themselves on national television, with a chance to win a small fortune; hosted by Adam Growe.
Two guys are quite confident when they get into the Cash Cab; they can't even imagine what other answer it could be.

Summer has arrived at Kew and everything in Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble's garden is blooming. Butterflies and bees abound and there are new crops to tend, harvest and cook with. Everyone loves a carrot, particularly the carrot fly, so Raymond must protect his crop to ensure he has a good supply for his summer carrot stew.

It's autumn at Kew and the vegetable garden is set to produce a bumper harvest. Raymond Blanc and Kate Humble grow some autumnal favourites and cook them up. Kate finds out why the tomato was once considered to be a deadly poison.

The end of the year at Kew is fast approaching, winter is setting in, but some crops positively love the cold and Raymond learns how brassicas cope in this frosty season. Kate visits Kew's Millennium Seed Bank.
Monty undertakes more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Arit Anderson meets a garden designer in Somerset who has worked in harmony with nature to create a garden on a former brownfield site.

From giant gooseberries and growing the perfect sweet pea to flamboyant dahlias and plants pollinated by a human hair, this week Monty celebrates the plant passions of some of the extraordinary people featured on the show over the last few years.
Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

Monty Don turns his attention to planting out his sweet peas and potting up lilies, and Carol Klein returns to Gloucestershire to help first-time gardeners, Dan and Dominique, plant up their new border in the style of a cottage garden.

The team travels to King George, Va. to investigate Belle Grove Plantation, which has ties to two U.S. presidents; in Winchester, Va., the team investigates historic Jordan Springs.

Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, N.J.; the historic Clay County Courthouse in Green Cove Springs, Fla.
To celebrate their 200th episode, the TAPS team returns to one of their favorite haunted locations: the Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum in Weston, W.V.
The TAPS team investigates reports of paranormal activity at the Cincinnati Music Hall in Ohio where the hauntings are said to be very frequent.
TAPS travels to St. Charles, Mo., to investigate hauntings on Main Street, where people experience unnerving sightings.
Three generations of a family inhabit a haunted estate in Joplin, Mo.; two properties in Barnstable, Mass., may be connected by one ghost.
After buying the building next door to their haunted theater in Woonsocket, R.I., the owners notice a spike in activity.
TAPS investigates the Wild Turkey Distillery in Kentucky, where it is believed the spirits of the founding family members reside.
TAPS investigates the Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, N.Y., to learn if the spirits of Jesuit priests still roamed the area.
TAPS investigates three deadly events that were not from battles at Fort Adams in Newport, R.I.
A family in Kentucky wants to know whether their ancestors still inhabit their property; investigating Old Cumberland County Prison in Pennsylvania.
A reinvestigation of Edith Wharton's home in Massachusetts after an increase in activity since the team's last investigation.
Investigating the renowned USS Constitution in Boston; re-enactors at Old Fort Harrod State Park have encountered spirits of early settlers.
A bride-to-be wants to determine if her dream wedding venue is safe; the team investigates Gallaher Mansion in Connecticut.

A grieving woman uses her TV to communicate with her deceased boyfriend; creatures with tentacles swim through the skies above Colorado; a heartbroken ghost gazes forlornly from the window of an abandoned home.
A spirit box session at an abandoned murder mansion goes awry; UFOs gather in a geometric formation in New Hampshire; a poltergeist plays the accordion in Russia.
A ghost toys with a dog in Arizona; a disembodied hand haunts an abandoned Mexican prison; night vision binoculars capture footage of UFOs hiding in plain sight.

A ghostly white figure lurks above a child's crib in England; a terrifying jinn in Saudi Arabia grows more powerful as a man attempts to capture proof of its existence; spirits try to trap a paranormal investigator inside an empty tomb.
A psychic medium can't shake an unfriendly spirit in Texas; ghost hunters in Thailand taunt the dead; a Massachusetts mother gets too close for comfort to the Grim Reaper.

Spirits take their seats in a haunted auditorium in Pakistan; a father and son on a hunting trip catch sight of a Sasquatch; a ghostly figure mysteriously fades away as it walks toward a morgue in Peru.
A man leaving work is startled by a gigantic UFO.
A drumming session in New York is interrupted by a chilling apparition; a ghostly guest visits an Indiana museum after hours; a giant portal opens in the sky above Oregon.
A UFO crashes a family gathering in Louisiana; in the ruins of Chernobyl, a mutated being terrifies hikers camping out for the night; a woman encounters Bigfoot's angrier, more canine-like cousin.
A shadow figure torments a cursed man in Colorado; dark spirits attack paranormal investigators at a castle; a terrifying creature lurks in a backyard.

Malicious spirits in a haunted rectory; a ghost startles a couple's dogs; a cruise ship captain spots UFOs off the coast of the Bahamas; a friendly spirit gives paranormal investigators a show; a man's drone spots what could be the Loch Ness monster.

A shadow figure sneaks around an abandoned Seattle restaurant; a roadside apparition chases after two motorcyclists in India; a California couple is baffled by a mysterious immobile object in the sky.
An Ohio man is horrified when his wife's doll collection comes to life; a UFO looms over a couple's house in Virginia; a toddler's ghostly playmate torments a family in Texas.

A ghost hunter is tormented by spirits at an abandoned rec center in Florida; a bizarre humanoid creature soars over Scotland; the unexplained Crossett lights mesmerize two friends on a remote dirt road in Arkansas.
Hundreds of UFOs crash Thanksgiving in Bangor, Pa.; a man in Pembroke, Wales has been living with a poltergeist for more than a decade; Sasquatch emerges from the woods in Madison, Tenn.

Jack and Katrina travel to Juneau, Alaska, to conduct the first-ever investigation of the Alaskan Hotel; built for luxury, the historic hotel has developed a reputation for demonic activity due to its notorious criminal past.

It's a real-life case of the Phantom of the Opera as Jack and Katrina descend on the sleepy town of McConnelsville, Ohio, to investigate a majestic old theater long rumored to be haunted by a host of sordid spirits.

After her mother dies, a young woman returns to her hometown to take custody of her 12-year-old half sister. As she confronts her troubled past, she finds solace in an old classmate who gave up his sports dreams to paint watercolors.
In the 10 years before the creation of Mickey Mouse, Walt Disney struggles to master the art and business of animation.
Encouraged by his grandfather, a boy faces his fears and makes new friends at summer camp.

Donna Lawrence, the survivor of a pit bull attack, adopts a pit bull mix puppy that was beaten, set afire and left for dead. Together, they learn to love and forgive as they seek justice and protection for all animals.
A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.
A look at the tough and adaptable wildlife living within the confines of Paris.
Malaysian superstar Michelle Yeoh returns to home to see her adopted orangutan for first time.

The interior of Brazil has ecosystems as different as dry forest and flood plains mix; this combination, which includes rivers, waterfalls and mountains, is home to a diverse and extremely rich fauna.
Showcases the lives of a white-breasted waterhen and orphaned lesser whistling ducklings in the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
Grassland is the Earth's second-largest ecosystem on land; China's grassland makes up an important part of the Eurasian Steppe.
Nirut tracks the elusive elephant trunk snake; the snake's habit of digging burrows in orchards puts them in conflict with fruit growers, triggering a rapid decline in the population.
On the Mediterranean island farthest from any mainland, where many flightless animals died out, we discover a story never told before.
A journey takes us across Japan's four main islands, unraveling its ancient and modern history.

Hugh builds a maternity room for his sow that is moments away from giving birth; he also contemplates how to install plumbing in his new headquarters; he challenges himself to put the neglected purple broccoli back on the culinary map.
On May Day, Hugh takes advantage of a healthy crowd that gathers on the Cerne Abbas Giant by selling his chocolate waffles; it is also opening night at the River Cottage headquarters.
Deep into the season, the harvest has been hearty for Hugh and the crew.
Five years after Hugh left the city behind, he and his family make the move to a much larger farm, with 44 acres of land and many more animals to look after.

Hugh installs beehives at the River Cottage headquarters; the only problem is his fear of being stung; he also takes on his biggest event yet — a wedding party; the newlyweds want their entire menu to only include wild or home-grown cuisine.

It is party season in Dorset and Hugh teams up with a local fisherman to catch whelks before spicing them up to sell on the beaches on Carnival Day; back at the River Cottage headquarters, Hugh is inspired to create the West Dorset Tomato Festival.
The day has arrived for Hugh to harvest his honey; with some help from Ken Bishop, they extract 25 lbs.; Hugh then enters some culinary delights into the Melplash Agricultural Show.

Hugh plans a sumptuous menu for a special Autumn feast he plans to throw at the River Cottage that includes a chicken feast, courtesy of Chickenopolis; it is also a good time to go mushroom hunting, but from the air.

The story of a middleweight boxer as he rises through ranks to earn his first shot at the middleweight crown. He falls in love with a gorgeous girl from the Bronx. The inability to express his feelings enters into the ring and eventually takes over his life. He eventually is sent into a downward spiral that costs him everything.

In Durham, N.C., the Bulls minor league baseball team has one asset no other can claim: a poetry-loving groupie named Annie Savoy (Susan Sarandon). As the team's season begins, Annie selects brash new recruit Ebby Calvin Laloosh (Tim Robbins), whom she christens "Nuke," to inspire with the religion of baseball. Nuke also receives guidance from veteran player Crash Davis (Kevin Costner), who settles Nuke's erratic pitching and teaches him to follow the catcher's lead.

When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

When diphtheria breaks out at Fort Humboldt, a train is dispatched with medical supplies and relief troops. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut, and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob.

But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.
Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull.

Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

Even though their raw talent and lofty aspirations gain the group notoriety, the pitfalls of fame begin to tear at their newfound friendships as they prepare for their big show. Based on the novel by Roddy Doyle.

Investigative reporter John Baxter (Tony Roberts) buys a notorious house in the Long Island suburb of Amityville, N.Y., in an attempt to prove that stories about its being inhabited by demons are fraudulent. But soon his daughter, Susan (Lori Loughlin), and her friend Lisa (Meg Ryan) are experiencing inexplicable terrors, while his estranged wife, Nancy (Tess Harper), and supernatural expert Elliot West (Robert Joy) fear that the evil has begun to spread outside the house's walls.

Outlaw Ben Wade (Russell Crowe) terrorizes 1800s Arizona, especially the Southern Railroad, until he is finally captured. In the American Southwest, Jim Kane (Paul Newman) scrapes a living as a cowboy. The trouble is, something always seems to go wrong. His latest job concerns transporting a herd of cattle from Mexico into the United States for shifty businessman Bill Garrett (Strother Martin). But Kane knows it won't be easy -- he only just lost money when the horses he tried to bring over were quarantined by customs. Desperate for pay, he goes ahead anyway, teaming up with his old partner, Leonard (Lee Marvin).

Sheep farmer Jason Sweet (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small Western cattle town and promptly clashes with local tough guy Jumbo McCall (Mickey Shaughnessy). With the entire town in an uproar over Sweet's behavior, Bedford arranges for Chocktaw Neal (Pernell Roberts), a seasoned gunslinger, to shoot him down.

In a poor African-American neighborhood in Los Angeles, once-aspiring poet Johnny Williams (James Earl Jones) takes a low-paying job as a house painter in order to support his family. Cooking up a tender lamb shoulder; super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta; one-pan fish; rice; apple crumble cookies.

Alan and Jane welcome their first ever guests to their brand-new purpose-built hotel boat, the Geanna. On arrival the guests enjoy the novelty factor, but Dan and Mardi think that space is too tight, while Jean-Pierre and Sarah are concerned about privacy. After inspecting their cabins, the Geanna embarks on her maiden voyage up the Thames.

Connoisseurs Sarah Langford and Jean-Pierre Kujawa have been running Sentry Mead, their 11-bedroom, five-star silver B&B for the past six years. Their guests arrive with high expectations, but Jane's high hopes are dashed by the mugs, Dan and Mardi don't like their shower mat, and Phil's not keen on the towels.
As the group meets for the last time, the payments are revealed and the winning B&B announced, but old tensions surface and there are heated exchanges around the table.

Alan and Sylvie are first to host in their seafront establishment Watersedge Guest House in Barton on Sea, Hampshire. The first guests to arrive are Blackpool boys Mike and Danny of Homecliffe Hotel, who locate dust and grime enough to grumble. Next through the door are Tim and Amelia, owners of Nearwater B&B, St Mawes. Austrian-born Eva of the Roundhouse Hotel in Weymouth, loves her spacious garden room.

It's Tim and Amelia's turn to host the rival B&B owners at their non-star-rated boutique accommodation, Nearwater, on the south Cornish coast. After a detailed inspection from Mike and Danny, they find fuel for their fire in some rather surprising places. Eva's feeling confident about a good night's sleep after testing the mattress, and Sylvie and Alan are still trying to get their head around what 'boutique' really means.

It's the turn of Austrian-born Eva Buschmann to host in her cosmopolitan boutique B&B on the Weymouth seafront, the Roundhouse Hotel. First to arrive are Danny and Mike who are a little shocked when Eva offers them a double room with an exposed shower.

Showmen Mike and Danny host their rival B&B owners on day four at their four-star rated guest house - Homecliffe Hotel - in Blackpool. After the harsh criticism Tim and Amelia received from Mike and Danny, the couple arrive at Homecliffe determined to find problems with the cleanliness of the room.
It's the final day and the B&B hosts gather for one last time to find out how much they've been paid. Unfortunately, some of the hosts find their emotions running away with them.

Piccolo Teatro is a bijou vegetarian restaurant in Paris run by feisty Scot Rachel. A former waitress at the restaurant, Rachel bought it three years ago and now, along with best friend Stephanie, she's trying to convert the carnivorous French into a nation of veggies. For Gordon, his trip to Piccolo Teatro turns into one of his biggest nightmares yet. Will he be able to perform a miracle, or admit defeat?

The Curry Lounge in Nottingham is a 120-seater Indian restaurant which has been run since January 2007 by ex-sales director Raz, who's new to the business, and it shows. Despite a £500,000 refurbishment and decor like a Bollywood set, the honeymoon period's well and truly over. Enter Gordon, relishing the prospect of tackling an Indian restaurant for the first time.

The Granary in rural Hampshire is an upmarket restaurant, which at 200 seats, is the biggest Gordon's ever taken on. Originally opened by entrepreneur Nigel Nieddu as an upmarket dining club four years ago, the restaurant was relaunched after a £2 million refit, but it's still losing £4,000 a week. It promises classy modern British cuisine but in reality the menu features food sourced from all over the globe.

Gordon visits the Fish & Anchor, a restaurant and bar near Lampeter in rural West Wales, owned and run by ex-boxer Mike and his wife Caron. Mike, a self-taught cook, is a one-man pressure cooker in the kitchen as he struggles to accommodate a vast menu, while Caron's unique style of front-of-house management includes abusing the customers and her husband in equal measure.

Robertsbrooke Guesthouse in Swanage is run by Claire Hilton, who feels she has got more than a sporting chance in the competition. However, her first guests Lynn Self and Ziggy Broome are dubious about the cleanliness of their bedroom.

Quirky couple Lynn Self and Ziggy Broome hope to impress with their two-star paradise Eden Lodge in Falmouth, Cornwall. However, with two of the guests - Charlotte Church's parents James and Maria Church - already saying that they wouldn't stay anywhere below a four star, it could be an interesting day. From the offset the guests are wildly unimpressed by their surroundings, from peeling wallpaper to a dirty toilet brush.

Dexby Townhouse in Cardiff is run by Charlotte Church's parents, James and Maria. The hosts lay on a day of white-water rafting in tight wetsuits and some magic tricks courtesy of Maria's young nephew Elliot. However, the next morning some of the guests are kept waiting for their breakfast.

It is the last stay of the competition and the turn of newlyweds Pip Easby and Nicky Lesser-Easby, who run Muddifords Court Country House in Devon. The Churches find their historical four-poster bed a bit small, while not all the guests enjoy the trip to a local glassblowing factory. Over dinner some of the participants say what they think of each other, and during the night James gets cold feet.

The group meet one last time to find out exactly how much they have been paid by their fellow hoteliers, and to air their grievances face to face. Claire suspects a disappointing payment from James and Maria Church, but an underpayment from a surprising source soon changes the group dynamics. As the final hosts Pip and Nicky prepare to open their envelope, it is still anyone's guess as to who will take the title.

The first to host is Mrs Tee of Gorse Meadow, a four star B&B in the New Forest. Her eccentric personality charms the guests on arrival but not everyone's room is up to scratch. John and Neil's bathroom window needs fixing and Alistair and Emma Mundell find they are sharing their room with ladybirds, cobwebs and dust.

It's Alistair and Emma Mundell's turn to host in sleepy Lynton, North Devon. Their four-star Castle Hill Guesthouse only opened three months ago, and the B&B newbies are desperate to impress with their recently renovated rooms. The accommodation proves a winner with Mark and Fee and John and Neil, but Mrs Tee is proving more difficult to please.

The competition heads north to Blackpool and the three-star Vidella, run by fun-loving best friends and business partners John and Neil. To pay back Alistair for being a self-confessed Blackpool-hater the Vidella boys have rigged his room with practical jokes. The fun continues at activity time as Neil appears in drag and leads the group to Funny Girls drag cabaret bar.

For the final visit the group checks into the boutique B&B Urban Beach in Bournemouth - run by local entrepreneur Mark Crib. With top prices of £170, the chic rooms come with all mod cons and super deluxe bathrooms. The afternoon's activity is a speedboat ride along the Jurassic coast. All the guests approve - even Mrs Tee is full of praise.

The hosts come face to face one last time to find out what they have been paid and to thrash out their differences. There's soon trouble as Mrs Tee finds out that it's Alistair and Emma who scored her one lowly point for cleanliness. The confrontation continues when the roles are reversed with a heated exchange resulting in a walk out.

Scott Sibella, the president and COO of the MGM Grand Las Vegas - the world's second-largest hotel - goes undercover. While working at the roulette table, Scott learns that the lack of ventilation in the casino is giving some of his staff health problems. Knowing this, can Scott change the company for the better?

Comedian and stage actress Carol Burnett, who first gained popularity during her stint on "The Gary Moore Show," hosted this one-hour variety series. Her talented supporting players included Harvey Korman, Tim Conway, Vicki Lawrence (who got the job based on her resemblance to Burnett) and Lyle Waggoner. Skits often featured guest stars, such as Mama Cass of the Mamas and the Papas or singer Steve Lawrence. One sketch, "The Family" (which featured Lawrence as the persnickety Mama and Burnett as her hotheaded daughter) was later spun-off into it's own sitcom.
